sessions.topic: Test whether 16 phase-resolved memory modes recover echoes across held-out and extrapolated pulse delays while conserving energy
sessions.boundary_reason: The extrapolated-delay result challenges the 16-mode hypothesis, prompting a revised approach.

sessions.topic: Evaluate adaptive 32-mode expansion on long delays and withheld three-pulse chirps
sessions.boundary_reason: The chirped-history error motivates a new phase-rotation hypothesis.

sessions.topic: Fit chirp-conditioned phase rotations, release EchoClosure-v1, and adopt the 32-mode closure
sessions.boundary_reason: The Hamiltonian memory-mode approach reaches a decision; the next proposal uses Hermite moments.

sessions.topic: Benchmark and select the reversible Hermite-moment closure for three-pulse chirps
sessions.boundary_reason: The Hermite closure reaches a selection decision before a distinct Volterra-kernel proposal.

sessions.topic: Test Volterra memory horizons and defer deployment after long-separation echo errors
sessions.boundary_reason: The Volterra approach reaches a deployment decision before the waterbag proposal.

sessions.topic: Train adaptive waterbags and benchmark 30-period pulse separations
sessions.boundary_reason: The next evaluation shifts from 30-period separations to withheld chirped four-pulse histories.

sessions.topic: Stress-test waterbags on four-pulse chirps, publish WB-Chirp-OOD, and restrict deployment
sessions.boundary_reason: The waterbag decision closes this approach before a latent-characteristic proposal.

sessions.topic: Test whether 64 advected phase markers recover four-pulse chirped echoes
sessions.boundary_reason: The 64-marker result misses the echo target, prompting a redistribution hypothesis.

sessions.topic: Evaluate chirp-triggered 128-marker redistribution and adopt MarkerEcho-v1
sessions.boundary_reason: The marker approach reaches a decision before the final cross-approach selection.

sessions.topic: Select closures by forcing-history regime and defer Volterra
